tasks.short: Request bids from suppliers or consultants.

steps.what: Define actual bid scope, required deliverables and qualified supplier or consultant shortlist
inputs: actual environmental project requirements
actual approved supplier and consultant records
outputs: engineer-defined bid scope, attachments, deadline and intended recipients

steps.what: Assemble the exact bid request package using native procurement request templates
inputs: engineer-defined bid scope, attachments, deadline and intended recipients
actual approved request terms
outputs: complete candidate bid request package and destinations

steps.what: Check and approve the complete final bid request, attachments and exact external recipients
inputs: complete candidate bid request package and destinations
outputs: approved final bid request package and exact external recipients

steps.what: Dispatch the approved final bid request package to the approved suppliers or consultants
inputs: approved final bid request package and exact external recipients
outputs: dispatched final bid requests

steps.what: Check actual dispatch receipts, failures and returned supplier questions
inputs: dispatched final bid requests
actual dispatch receipts and supplier responses
outputs: actual request delivery findings and unresolved questions

tasks.design: Configure {PROCUREMENT} bid request templates and version-bound supplier dispatch using actual engineer-defined scope and {DOCS} attachments. The engineer approves the complete final package and exact recipients before a separate external dispatch. Actual delivery checks remain human; no bid response or supplier acceptance is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Scope, terms, attachments and recipients may be repeatedly assembled into individual bid requests.
tasks.enabler_now: Native procurement templates and dispatch can reuse exact human-approved request fields.
tasks.still_hard: Writing an adequate technical scope and choosing suitable recipients.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer recognises ambiguous requirements that would produce incomparable bids.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated bid package preparation and real dispatch work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: procurement systems support exact bid request templates and approved recipient dispatch; this configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual package assembly and real recipient/attachment dispatch after current procurement settings. Already automated native sends, one-click saves and runtime earn no benefit.

s1 captures actual scope_text, deliverables, attachment_ids, deadline and supplier_ids at full time. Actual procurement owners already supply terms_version and supplier_contacts. Missing fields or unsupported destinations use manual preparation and dispatch.

s3 retains full final scope, terms, attachment and destination review. Any package or recipient change voids approval. s5 checks actual delivery and returned questions; any later outgoing clarification requires its own final-version approval and send. No new capture is transferred to others.
unknowns: Existing bid template and dispatch coverage
research_questions: Which actual bid assembly and recipient dispatch remains manual after current procurement templates?

incremental.description: Maintain bid request field mappings and dispatch exception checks

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete final bid request, attachments and exact external recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross = 30 package assembly plus 10 real dispatch = 40 less 2 upkeep = 38. Low changes only half of assembly and leaves dispatch manual: 15 less 2 = 13.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Inform employees or interested parties of environmental issues.

steps.what: Verify the actual environmental issue, source facts and intended employee audience
inputs: actual environmental issue records
actual communication purpose and audience
outputs: engineer-checked issue facts and communication intent

steps.what: Assemble exact source facts and approved links using native environmental notice templates
inputs: engineer-checked issue facts and communication intent
outputs: candidate exact environmental issue fact section

steps.what: Draft and check plain-language environmental issue explanations against the actual source facts
inputs: candidate exact environmental issue fact section
engineer-checked issue facts and communication intent
outputs: engineer-checked complete candidate environmental notice

loop.purpose: Explain variable environmental issues in clear employee language
loop.input: Actual verified facts, intended meaning, source references and engineer chosen actions
loop.output: Candidate explanation preserving uncertainty and exact human chosen actions
loop.check: Engineer checks every claim, implication, omission and action against source facts and communication intent, including any false reassurance
loop.stop: Missing source or two failed corrections returns to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native templates handle fixed facts first; variable explanations and audience wording need substantive prose checking

steps.what: Approve the complete final environmental notice, source caveats and exact employee recipients
inputs: engineer-checked complete candidate environmental notice
outputs: approved final environmental notice and exact employee recipients

steps.what: Send the approved final environmental notice to the approved employees
inputs: approved final environmental notice and exact employee recipients
outputs: sent final environmental notice

steps.what: Read actual employee responses and identify issues requiring clarification
inputs: sent final environmental notice
actual employee responses
outputs: actual employee questions and clarification needs

tasks.design: Configure native {DOCS} environmental notice fields from actual {PROJECT} facts, with a bounded prose loop only for variable explanation. The engineer checks meaning and approves the complete final notice and employee recipients before its separate send. Actual responses remain human work; no compliance or safe condition is inferred.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual environmental facts may be recopied and explained separately for employee notices.
tasks.enabler_now: Native fact templates and bounded source-grounded drafting can reduce repeated notice composition.
tasks.still_hard: Accurate risk communication and avoiding false reassurance.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer judges what people need to understand and when the evidence is insufficient.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated notice composition with full human risk communication control.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: exact document templates and bounded source-grounded drafting can prepare candidate notices; this is a proposed design.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual fact copying and explanation writing after current notice templates; existing generated facts earn no saving.

s1 retains full capture and checking of actual issue_id, observed_facts, source_reference, caveats, chosen_action and audience. Missing content is resolved manually. s3 retains 15 hours for complete meaning checks and correction; s4 retains full final approval.

The worked boundary is an internal employee notice. Changed text, attachments or audience requires renewed approval before send. Actual clarification needs are observed after actual responses; any outgoing follow-up needs its own final version and approval.
research_questions: Which factual fields and explanations are still repeatedly composed for environmental notices?

incremental.description: Maintain environmental notice source mappings and audit explanatory fidelity

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final environmental notice and exact employee recipients

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross = 20 exact fact assembly plus 25 times 40% prose = 30 less 2 upkeep = 28. Low changes half of fact assembly and leaves prose manual: 10 less 2 = 8. Send and responses remain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Liaise with agencies about solid or hazardous waste program requirements.

steps.what: Reconcile actual waste program requirements, prior agency correspondence and source versions using native case views
inputs: actual waste program issue
actual current requirements and agency correspondence
outputs: engineer-checked waste program liaison context

steps.what: Write and approve the complete final agency brief and exact authorised official recipient
inputs: engineer-checked waste program liaison context
actual liaison purpose and disclosure authority
outputs: approved final waste program brief and exact agency recipient

steps.what: Send the approved final waste program brief to the approved agency official
inputs: approved final waste program brief and exact agency recipient
outputs: sent final waste program agency brief

steps.what: Liaise with actual agency officials to clarify solid or hazardous waste program requirements
inputs: sent final waste program agency brief
actual agency questions and responses
outputs: actual agency liaison findings and unresolved requirements

steps.what: Write and approve actual agency clarifications, remaining uncertainty and waste program actions
inputs: actual agency liaison findings and unresolved requirements
outputs: approved final actual waste program liaison record

steps.what: Save the approved actual waste program liaison record
inputs: approved final actual waste program liaison record
outputs: saved actual waste program liaison record

tasks.design: Configure native waste program requirement and correspondence links in {PROJECT} and {DOCS}. The engineer prepares and approves the final brief before a separate agency send, then liaises with actual officials. Actual received clarification is written and approved before its separate save; a sent brief is not agency approval.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current requirements and prior agency correspondence may be manually reconciled before liaison.
tasks.enabler_now: Native case views can retain exact correspondence and requirement versions.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, differing agency interpretations and incomplete actual responses.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer asks precise questions and recognises unresolved requirements.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated correspondence reconciliation before human agency liaison.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project document views can expose versioned requirements and correspondence; this configuration is proposed.

assumptions: Shares are provisional. Verify residual correspondence reconciliation after current project views; existing search and runtime earn no benefit.

Actual program records already supply program_id, requirement_version, correspondence_id, agency and response_date. s1 retains 10 hours for scope, currency and missing records; absent records use manual preparation. No new agency capture is assumed.

s2 approves complete final text and exact agency destination. Changed content requires renewed approval. s5 records actual responses after liaison; same-system save earns no benefit. No legal applicability claim is treated as established by this workflow design.
research_questions: Which actual correspondence and requirement reconciliation remains manual?

incremental.description: Maintain waste program correspondence and requirement links

approvals.approved_version: s2 complete final waste program brief and exact agency official
s5 complete final actual waste program liaison record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only reconciliation changes: 20 times 50% = 10 less 1 upkeep = 9. Low halves that benefit: 5 less 1 = 4.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Support projects through data collection, documentation, staff training and general administration.

steps.what: Collect and verify actual project status, source measurements and staff training requirements
inputs: actual project records and source measurements
actual staff learning needs
outputs: engineer-captured actual project facts and training requirements

steps.what: Populate exact project documentation sections using native project report templates
inputs: engineer-captured actual project facts and training requirements
outputs: candidate exact project administration documentation

steps.what: Prepare staff training materials using native approved procedure and course templates
inputs: engineer-captured actual project facts and training requirements
actual approved project procedures
outputs: engineer-checked candidate staff training materials

steps.what: Check and approve complete final project documents and staff training materials
inputs: candidate exact project administration documentation
engineer-checked candidate staff training materials
outputs: approved final project documents and training materials for exact staff group

steps.what: Save the approved final project documentation and training materials
inputs: approved final project documents and training materials for exact staff group
outputs: saved final project documents and training materials

steps.what: Train the actual staff group using approved materials and answer actual project questions
inputs: approved final project documents and training materials for exact staff group
actual staff participation
outputs: actual staff training observations and attendance

steps.what: Record and approve actual staff attendance, questions and demonstrated training outcomes
inputs: actual staff training observations and attendance
outputs: approved final actual staff training record

steps.what: Commit the approved actual staff training record
inputs: approved final actual staff training record
outputs: saved actual staff training record

tasks.design: Configure native {PROJECT} documentation and {LMS} course templates from actual checked project facts. The engineer approves complete final documents and teaching materials before separate storage and actual staff training. Actual attendance and outcomes are captured after training, approved and separately committed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Project facts and approved procedure content may be recopied into documentation and training packs.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project and learning templates can reuse exact actual fields and approved procedure versions.
tasks.still_hard: Source validity, training suitability and actual staff understanding.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer connects project administration to what staff actually need to do safely.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated project documentation with human staff training retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: project and learning systems support exact documentation and course templates; this connection is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual project field and training pack copying after current native templates; existing auto-filled reports and runtime earn no benefit.

s1 retains full capture and verification of actual project_id, status_date, observed_status, source_reference, procedure_version and staff_group. s2 uses exact fields only; s3 retains 7.5 hours for training applicability checks. Missing source content uses manual documentation and preparation.

s4 approves complete final artefacts and exact staff group before each action. s7 captures actual attendance and observed outcomes only after s6; an invitation or plan never substitutes for completion. Changed artefacts require renewed approval. Same-system saves and commits earn no benefit.
research_questions: Which actual project fields and procedure extracts are still recopied across documents and training materials?

incremental.description: Maintain actual project documentation and training field mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final project documentation and training materials
s4 complete final staff training materials and exact staff group
s7 complete final actual attendance and training outcome record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross = 20 exact documentation plus 15 times 50% training preparation = 27.5 less 1.5 upkeep = 26. Low changes only half of exact documentation, leaving training preparation manual: 10 less 1.5 = 8.5.
